body.statement: When \(k=0\), the cutoff construction reduces extensionally to the ordinary three-state forest recurrence. When \(C_G\) has no edges, \(S_{\ell}=V\) for every rule and the RDIM construction reduces to balanced complete randomization on all \(n\) units.
body.justification: The reduction checks both the new algorithmic boundary and the classical experimental-design limit.
body.gap: The feedback-core proposal must recover the parent's forest recurrence and cannot alter RDIM on an interference-free graph.
body.consumer: Implementers obtain regression tests at \(k=0\) and at the no-interference design.
